title: There is something sinister in you...
html_source: He says this due to his behavioral patterns, which are commented on by more than just Mulligan. Later on in the chapter another “fellow on the ship” that Mulligan was with said he thought Stephen had “g.p.i”. General paralysis of the insane. G.p.i. is the last stage of syphilis, and so Mulligan’s scurrilous talk marks Stephen with a sexual taint.
